title: Quadrilateral
summary: QUADRILAT'ERAL, adjective [Latin quadra, or quatuor, four, and latus, side.] Having four sides and four angles. QUADRILAT'ERAL, noun A figure having four sides and four angles; a quadrangular figure.

inlines.v: QUADRILAT'ERAL, adjective [Latin quadra, or quatuor, four, and latus, side.] Having four sides and four angles. QUADRILAT'ERAL, noun A figure having four sides and four angles; a quadrangular figure.
